Specification: This module specifies a real-time refinement of an hour clock by adding a real-time variable now and an auxiliary timer variable t. It constrains elapsed time between hour-clock ticks HCnxt so that each tick occurs within a tolerance window determined by SecondsPerHour and Rho, and it also states progress/fairness properties ensuring time can continue to advance. The specification includes state predicates and temporal formulas for timer behavior, upper and lower timing bounds, non-Zeno progress, recurrence of every hour value, and an error temporal property about now remaining different from 4.
